svg.text: 384 surrounding trees • leafy underlay • scenery remains outside the arena
Top-down placement diagram; lighting and appearance must be viewed in Roblox Studio.
Dashed square = 550 × 550 stud playable bounds. All forest geometry lies outside it.
Trees overlap at player height; collision, touch, and queries are disabled.
